title: Operating-scenario choices consumed by the physics seam; constraint-derived inputs are references to engineering_constraints_v1 (not restated)
rule: abep_sim/operating_inputs.py (physics seam) reads this file and engineering_constraints_v1 through abep_sim.configuration.load_operating_inputs (fail closed; the constraints pin above is verified). Inputs of kind CONSTRAINT_REFERENCE carry no value (single source: engineering_constraints_v1); inputs of kind OPERATING_SCENARIO_CHOICE are an operating-scenario choice, distinct from the engineering constraint it was set equal to when this file was built (set_equal_to_constraint): physics consumes the choice; the assessment compares results with the constraint. Editing the constraint file alone changes the assessment, not this choice. The 26,000 -> 26,280 h change is the governed A9.22 G1 migration, APPLIED (docs/HISTORY.md).

altitude_domain_km.note: value not restated here: read from engineering_constraints_v1 constraints.altitude_band_km

xe_sizing_thrust_target_mN.role: thrust target for Xe sizing / T_req floor of the closure

wet_mass_limit_kg.note: value not restated here: read from engineering_constraints_v1 constraints.wet_mass_max_kg

mission_hours.role: mission-integration horizon (mission-duration basis for mission-integrated quantities; A9.22 G1)
mission_hours.label: MISSION_DURATION_BASIS
g1_migrated_consumers: abep_sim/system.py AO fluence / erosion depths, cathode starts, eng_R_mission (operating_inputs.MISSION_HOURS)

historical_note.label: HISTORICAL_CONSTANT_NOT_CONSUMED
historical_note.note: pre-A9.22 basis (abep_sim.constants.RFP.mission_hours, immutable); no consumer computes with it
